breakpoints.note: one layout step (canon `max-width: 991px` inverted); `npm run lint` runs breakpoint-lint

foundation.classNaming: canon classes with BEM `__` and `--` flattened to `-` (stylelint kebab-case): .btn--primary -> .btn-primary, .eyebrow--line -> .eyebrow-line, .site-header__bar -> .site-header-bar

fonts.Source Sans 3: 400/600/900, self-hosted woff2 in /fonts, @font-face in styles/fonts.css (late, swap); metric-matched source-sans-3-fallback (local Arial) in styles.css

container..ifx-fixed: max-width 1400 + --ifx-gutter padding (1248 content at 1440) — blocks cap their content with it

classes.sectionModel: main > .section and its block wrappers are FULL-BLEED (margin/padding 0, no max-width); .default-content-wrapper gets the 1400 shell + gutters. A block that must cap at 1400 puts .ifx-fixed (or .ifx-shell) on its own inner wrapper.
classes.reset: global border-box; h1-h6/p/ul/ol/figure margin 0; ul/ol list-style none + padding 0; a inherits colour, no underline (default-content links are teal); img block max-width 100% height auto

buttons.authored: <strong><a> -> a.button.primary (teal fill), <em><a> -> a.button.secondary (teal outline on white), <strong><em><a> -> a.button.accent (white fill, teal text: on-dark)
buttons.utility: .btn + .btn-primary | .btn-outline | .btn-white (same paint, for block-built non-authored controls only)

links..link-arrow, .link-arrow-wrap :where(a): teal 18/26 600 + arrow glyph ::after (wrapper variant survives edit mode)

icons.glyphNames: scripts.js GLYPH_ICONS + every ico-* name render from the infineon-icons font via .icon-NAME::before (no , no /icons fetch); size with font-size
icons.svgIcons: any other name -> stock /icons/NAME.svg in a 24px box (shipped: logo, infineon-logo-inverted, tiktok)
icons.jsApi: import { decorateGlyphIcons, GLYPH_ICONS } from '../../scripts/scripts.js' for icon spans a block builds itself before decorateIcons; spans built AFTER decoration need no call
icons.available: accordion-circle arrow-right article cart check chevron-down chevron-left chevron-right chips code cross dot facebook globe instagram left-arrow linkedin map-pin medal media-pause media-play menu money plus right-arrow search table user video youtube + ico-applications-* ico-design-* ico-product-* (see styles.css)

classes.editMode: styles.css ships the .prosemirror-editor CTA repaint + card-link inner anchor reset

header.block: blocks/header (loads /nav, or the page's `nav` metadata path)
header.height: var(--nav-height) reserved on <header>; header is static (scrolls away, no sticky)
header.navDocument:
sections: 1 brand link (:logo:), 2
    top items (link >
      categories: optional :ico-*: icon + link or text >
        links), then styled sections search | language | currency | account (first

        = login link) | cart | news (section-metadata `menus` = comma list of top item names)
header.events: root dispatches `site-header:panel` ({ li, mega }) when a top item opens

footer.block: blocks/footer (loads /footer, or the page's `footer` metadata path)
footer.footerDocument:
sections: 1 logo link (:infineon-logo-inverted:), 2 repeated

title +

    link columns, 3 legal
      + copyright

      , 4 social

        of icon links (title = label)
footer.spacing: footer has no top margin; the last page section owns the gap above it

chrome.notShipped: the Ask-AI launcher (.da-launcher) and the third-level product menus are not part of the foundation

martech: scripts/martech.js unchanged (all routes + CMP disabled); loadEager imports it and calls loadConsent(); consent-check.js loads in loadDelayed
lang: document lang = de under /de, else en (scripts.js loadEager)
